a.text: Observe how ants move and apples grow.
An axe is for grown-ups. We look, not touch.
Build a tall tree with blocks.
Draw and colour a shiny red apple.
Compare sizes of apple, ant and axe.

b.text: Observe how a ball rolls and bounces.
Identify the school bus as transportation
Explore the wheels that help buses move.
Draw and colour a bat and ball.
Identify the round shape of the ball.

c.text: Observe the cat’s soft fur and movement.
Explore simple tools used for baking cakes.
Notice how cake layers are stacked carefully.
Decorate a colourful birthday cake creatively.
Count the visible layers of the cake.

d.text: Observe how dogs and ducks move differently.
Explore how a drum produces sound.
Notice the round structure of the drum.
Create simple patterns for a toy drum.
Count the dog, duck and drum.

e.text: Observe how eyes help us see things.
Look at an egg through a magnifying glass.
Notice the strong curved shape of eggs.
Draw and colour an eagle and egg.
Compare the sizes of eagle and egg.

f.text: Observe how fish live and move in water.
Explore how aquariums provide homes for fish.
Notice how an aquarium safely holds water.
Draw and colour a bright tropical fish.
Sort the fruits by colour and size.

g.text: Observe what goats eat and how grapes grow.
Explore tools farmers use to collect grapes.
Make a little path with blocks for the goat.
Draw and colour a bunch of grapes.
Compare the sizes of goat and grapes.

h.text: Observe how horses and hens move differently.
Explore tools used to care for horses.
Notice how fences keep farm animals safe.
Design and colour a beautiful hat.
Compare the sizes of horse and hen.

i.text: Observe how ice melts when it becomes warm.
Explore how freezers keep ice cold.
Notice how containers safely hold liquids.
Compare the sizes of ice cubes.

j.text: Observe how soft jelly changes its shape.
Identify the jeep as a transport vehicle.
Explore how wheels help a jeep move.
Create colourful jelly shapes and patterns.
Compare the sizes of jelly pieces.

k.text: The teacher shows hot steam. Children watch, never touch.
Identify the kettle as a useful appliance.
Explore how a key fits into a lock.
Draw and decorate a royal crown.
Compare the sizes of key and kettle.

l.text: Observe how lions and lizards live differently.
Carry the lemons in a basket.
Stack stones and blocks to build a strong tower.
Draw and colour bright yellow lemons.
Count the lemons growing on the plant.

m.text: Observe the moon and different animal movements.
Explore tools used to observe the moon.
Build a tall tower with blocks to reach the moon.
Draw and colour a bright round moon.
Compare the sizes of monkey and mouse.

n.text: Observe how birds build nests for their eggs.
Identify a net as a useful catching tool.
Explore how twigs make a strong nest.
Draw and colour a bird’s nest.
Count the nuts placed near the tree.

o.text: Observe how an owl and ostrich differ.
Explore tools used to observe birds safely.
Notice how strong bird legs support movement.
Draw and colour a round onion.
Count the onions shown in the scene.

p.text: Observe what pandas and parrots like to eat.
Explore tools used to grow and collect fruits.
Notice how a bird perch supports the parrot.
Draw and colour a pear and parrot.
Compare the sizes of panda, parrot and pear.

q.text: Observe the feathers and movement of a quail.
Explore tools used for stitching a quilt.
Notice how fabric pieces join to make a quilt.
Create a colourful patchwork quilt pattern.
Identify and count the shapes in the quilt.

r.text: Observe how a rocket travels through the sky.
Explore how a remote controls a robot.
Notice the different parts of robots and rockets.
Design and colour a creative toy rocket.
Compare the sizes of rocket, robot and rabbit.

s.text: Observe how the sun gives us light and warmth.
Explore simple tools we use for eating.
Notice the curved shape of a spoon.
Draw and colour a bright shining sun.
Compare the sizes of sparrow and spoon.

t.text: Observe how tomatoes grow on a plant.
Explore tools used for growing healthy plants.
Notice how a strong tree trunk supports branches.
Draw and colour a tiger and tomatoes.
Count the tomatoes growing on the plant.

u.text: Observe how rain makes outdoor surfaces wet.
Explore how an umbrella protects us from rain.
Notice how the umbrella opens and closes.
Design a colourful pattern for an umbrella.
Identify the different sections of the umbrella.

v.text: Identify different vegetables and how they help us grow.
Explore how a van carries people and goods.
Notice how wheels help the van move.
Observe and create decorative patterns on a vase.
Sort the vegetables by colour, shape or size.

w.text: Observe how water flows through the rocky stream.
Explore how a watch helps us know time.
Notice how bicycle wheels help it move.
Draw and colour a beautiful mountain scene.
Identify the round shapes of watch and wheels.

x.text: An X-ray is a special photo of our bones.
The doctor takes this photo with a big camera.
Notice how different xylophone bars produce sounds.
Create a colourful pattern using xylophone bars.
Count and compare the xylophone bars.

y.text: Observe the movement of a yoyo going up and down.
Explore how a yacht travels across water.
Notice how the yoyo string controls its movement.
Design and colour a beautiful yoyo.
Compare the sizes of yoyo, yacht and yak.

z.text: Observe the unique black and white stripes of a zebra.
Explore how a zip opens and closes a bag.
Notice how interlocking zip teeth work together.
Create a black-and-white zebra stripe pattern.
Identify and repeat the alternating stripe pattern.
